# Chip Design MCP — LLM Context

Full corpus: **llms-full.txt**. Fleet standards: **mcp-central-docs** (`SOTA_REQUIREMENTS.md`, `chip_design_cad_sota.md`).

Chip Design MCP is a FastMCP 3.2 server for open-source ASIC/VLSI orchestration — framed as a **superyacht magazine for silicon** (read docs/DREAMING_IN_SILICON.md): educate what COULD be done with FOSS sky130 flows, run real tools when asked, warn users (Docker, heuristics, no foundry guarantee). KiCad/kicad-mcp is for PCBs; this repo is RTL→GDSII. It exposes 32+ MCP tools across 6 domains, Prefab cards, prompts/resources, bundled **skill://chip-design-expert**, and **chip_agentic** sampling — covering the full RTL-to-GDSII pipeline.

**Install (Windows):** clone https://github.com/sandraschi/chip-design-mcp and run `.\start.bat` — winget uv/Node, `uv sync --extra eda`, automated Docker+WSL+volare (see **INSTALL.md**). No manual apt steps for naked-PC users.

Discovery: `GET http://127.0.0.1:11022/.well-known/mcp/manifest.json` (stdio + HTTP). Claude Desktop: root **manifest.json** + `just mcpb-pack`.

## Key Files

| Path | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `src/chip_design_mcp/server.py` | FastMCP + FastAPI gateway, 460 lines |
| `src/chip_design_mcp/tools/synthesis.py` | 6 Yosys synthesis tools: status, read, run, stats, show, export |
| `src/chip_design_mcp/tools/simulation.py` | 4 cocotb+iverilog tools: list, run, waveform, coverage |
| `src/chip_design_mcp/tools/place_route.py` | 7 OpenLane tools: status, create, configure, run, reports, gds, lef |
| `src/chip_design_mcp/tools/verification.py` | 4 verification tools: drc, lvs, timing, formal |
| `src/chip_design_mcp/tools/standard_cells.py` | 4 PDK tools: list, info, search, stats |
| `src/chip_design_mcp/tools/depot.py` | 3 project tools: init, list, status + template generators |
| `webapp/` | React 19 + Vite 6 + Tailwind + TypeScript dashboard |
| `webapp/start.ps1` | Naked-PC launcher (6 steps, automated EDA) |
| `scripts/install-eda.ps1` | Docker OpenLane + WSL yosys + volare sky130 |
| `docs/PRD.md` | Product requirements |
| `docs/FOSS_EDA_ECOSYSTEM.md` | FOSS CAD: Chisel, LiteX, Yosys, nextpnr, LibreLane, OpenRAM, KiCad vs ASIC |
| `docs/DREAMING_IN_SILICON.md` | Editorial — ethos, warnings, KiCad epilogue |
| `docs/FOSS_RTL_SOURCES.md` | External RTL: neuraedge, OpenSpike, PicoRV32, HighTide, Tiny Tapeout |
| `INSTALL.md` | Canonical install guide |
| `justfile` | bootstrap, serve, install-eda, yosys-check, docker-check, pdk-check |

## Architecture

```
MCP Client/LLM → HTTP/SSE → FastMCP → yosys (subprocess, Verilog→netlist)
                                     → iverilog/vvp (subprocess, simulation)
                                     → OpenLane (Docker/subprocess, RTL→GDS)
                                     → magic/netgen (subprocess, DRC/LVS)
```

The server discovers EDA tools at startup from PATH. Tools are registered via `register_*_tools(mcp, state, run_eda, ...)` closures — the kicad-mcp pattern.

## Ports

| Port | Service |
|------|---------|
| 11022 | Backend (FastAPI + FastMCP) |
| 11023 | Frontend (Vite dev) |

## Quick Start

```powershell
just bootstrap
just serve
# Open http://localhost:11023
```

## Tool Categories

- **Synthesis** (6): syn_status, syn_read_verilog, syn_run, syn_stats, syn_show, syn_export_netlist
- **Simulation** (4): sim_list_tests, sim_run_testbench, sim_read_waveform, sim_check_coverage
- **Place & Route** (7): pr_status, pr_create_design, pr_configure, pr_run_flow, pr_read_reports, pr_export_gds, pr_export_lef
- **Verification** (4): verify_drc, verify_lvs, verify_timing, verify_formal
- **Standard Cells** (4): cells_list, cells_info, cells_search, cells_stats
- **Depot** (3): depot_init, depot_list, depot_status
- **System** (3): chip_status, chip_pipeline_stages, chip_available_pdks

## PDK Support

- SkyWater 130nm (`sky130`) — via volare
- GlobalFoundries 180nm (`gf180mcu`) — via volare
- IHP SG13G2 130nm BiCMOS (`ihp-sg13g2`) — via volare

## Production Paths

- TinyTapeout (~$100) — shared MPW shuttle
- Efabless/Google shuttle (free for open-source)
